sourceTitle: Chocolate Banana Smoothie with Goji Berries
sourceText:
Chocolate Banana Smoothie with Goji Berries
By: Sharon Chen
Published: Friday, July 14, 2017 - 5:29am

Ingredients




1 cup almond milk
1 ½ frozen banana, cut into chunks
¼ cup Greek plain yogurt
1 tablespoon cocoa powder
1 tablespoon goji berries

Preparation

1 Add almond milk into a blender, followed by banana. Add yogurt and top with cocoa powder, and goji berries. Blend on high speed till smooth.

About

5-ingredient chocolate banana smoothie features goji berries and it’s packed with protein, vitamins, fiber, calcium, and deliciousness.
